items.exampleEn: The tiger roared ferociously at the visitors.
items.exampleZh: 老虎對著遊客兇猛地咆哮。

items.exampleEn: His teammates never forgave his desertion of the team before the final.
items.exampleZh: 他的隊友們始終無法原諒他在決賽前拋下球隊離開。

items.exampleEn: He stared glumly at the rain outside the window.
items.exampleZh: 他悶悶不樂地盯著窗外的雨。

items.exampleEn: The island has a beguiling mix of old temples and quiet beaches.
items.exampleZh: 這座島融合了古老寺廟和寧靜海灘，令人著迷。

items.exampleEn: The lethargic cat barely lifted its head when I came in.
items.exampleZh: 我進門時，那隻懶洋洋的貓幾乎連頭都沒抬。

items.exampleEn: The two companies are still wrangling about the price.
items.exampleZh: 兩家公司還在為價格爭執不休。

items.exampleEn: We took an aimless drive along the coast on Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 星期天我們沿著海岸漫無目的地兜風。
items.glossZh: 漫無目的的；沒有方向的

items.exampleEn: The cleverness of the design surprised everyone.
items.exampleZh: 這個設計的巧妙讓所有人都很驚訝。

items.sentenceEn: Long meetings after lunch leave many staff feeling lethargic.
items.sentenceZh: 午餐後的冗長會議讓許多員工提不起勁。

items.audioEn: The two brothers wrangled for months over who should keep the old car they had bought together.
items.audioZh: 兩兄弟為了誰該留下他們合買的那輛舊車，爭了好幾個月。
items.questionZh: 兄弟倆爭了好幾個月的是什麼？
options: How to share the cost of a new house
Who would get the old car

items.sentenceEn: Her beguiling smile made it hard to say no to her.
items.sentenceZh: 她迷人的笑容讓人很難拒絕她。

items.sentenceEn: She defended her research ferociously at the conference.
items.sentenceZh: 她在研討會上激烈地為自己的研究辯護。

items.stemEn: Without any plan, the long weekend felt slow and ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有任何計畫，這個長週末過得緩慢又漫無目的。

items.stemEn: The neighbors ____ for years over the height of the fence between their gardens.
items.stemZh: 兩家鄰居為了花園之間圍籬的高度爭吵了好幾年。

items.passageEn: After the paper factory closed, the slow desertion of the village by its young people left Marlow half empty. Those who stayed felt lethargic, and the village council spent years wrangling over plans that never happened. Then Hana, a former teacher with a beguiling way of telling stories, returned home. She noticed teenagers wandering about, bored and aimless, and decided to give them a project: a festival of stories. Some neighbors glumly predicted that nobody would come. Hana fought ferociously for a small budget, and with real cleverness she turned the empty shops into stages. The first festival drew three thousand visitors, and the local paper commended her for her energy.
items.passageZh: 造紙廠關閉後，年輕人一個個離開，讓 Marlow 村空了一半。留下來的人提不起勁，村議會花了好幾年爭論那些從未實現的計畫。後來，說故事很迷人的前老師 Hana 回到家鄉。她注意到青少年漫無目的地到處閒晃，便決定給他們一個任務：辦一場說故事節。有些鄰居悶悶不樂地預言不會有人來。Hana 拚命爭取到一筆小預算，還很巧妙地把空店面變成表演場地。第一屆說故事節吸引了三千名遊客，當地報紙也讚揚她的活力。

questions.questionZh: Hana 回來時，青少年是什麼樣子？
Hana 怎麼解決表演場地的問題？
options: 向議會申請在學校操場搭帳篷

items.promptZh: 大家都很佩服她解決這個問題的聰明才智。
referenceEn: Everyone admired her cleverness in solving this problem.
Everyone was impressed by the cleverness she showed in solving the problem.
rubricZh: 「聰明才智」用名詞 cleverness（例如 her cleverness）
「佩服」可寫，例如 admired、was impressed by 等
「解決問題」可寫，例如 in solving the problem 等

items.promptZh: 小男孩悶悶不樂地看著他的冰淇淋掉在地上。
referenceEn: The little boy watched glumly as his ice cream fell on the ground.
The little boy glumly watched his ice cream drop to the ground.
rubricZh: 「悶悶不樂地」用 glumly，位置有彈性（例如 watched glumly、glumly watched 等）
「掉在地上」可寫，例如 fell on the ground、drop to the ground 等
時態配合內容（例如 watched 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
